state.message:
fix(cache): evict on write

Stale reads appeared because writes updated the database but left the cached entry, so readers saw old values until the TTL expired. Evicting on write trades one extra miss for correctness.

feat(auth): add refresh tokens

Sessions expired mid-task for users on long runs. Short-lived access tokens stay (limits leak exposure) and a rotating refresh token renews them; rejected a longer access TTL because revocation would lag.

refactor(parser): split tokenizer from parser

The tokenizer and parser shared mutable state, which made the error-recovery tests order-dependent. Separating them lets each be tested alone; behaviour is unchanged.

docs: explain why trunk delivery is the default

Contributors kept opening pull requests for one-line fixes. The README now states that trunk-based delivery with CI on every push is the default because it keeps feedback fast; PRs remain opt-in per repo.

feat: add export

- adds export function
- adds tests
- updates readme

perf(search): index titles at write time

Profiling showed 70% of request time scanning titles per query. Indexing on write moves cost to the rarer operation; the index adds about 2 MB per 100k documents, which is acceptable.
